## Fight with Two Swords

Two swords, one in each hand: more blades than an enemy can watch, and the start of a road that ends at three.

Fight with the Nitoryu style.

**Tasks**

- Fight as Nitoryu

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000, +5 Training Points (your style)

## Gokuraku Anyo Rashomon

The second draw of Rashomon, with everything two swords can carry behind it.

Unlock Gokuraku Anyo Rashomon and reach 30,000 Doriki.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [72 and 720 Pound Ho](st_nitoryu.md#q-360b16525e02eaee), [Toro Samon](st_nitoryu.md#q-584133559e2f7703)

**Tasks**

- Unlock Gokuraku Anyo Rashomon
- Reach 30,000 Doriki

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +60,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +8 Training Points (your style)
